text: Skip to main content Filing Information Returns Electronically (FIRE) English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In Tax Pros Enrolled agents Annual Filing Season Program participants Enrolled retirement plan agents Certified Professional Employer Organization (CPEO) EITC central Enrolled actuaries E-file providers Modernized e-File Modernized e-File status Become an authorized e-file provider Authorized IRS E-file Provider Locator Service QuickAlerts Electronic filing options for business and self-employed taxpayers Modernized e-File forms Approved IRS Modernized e-File business providers FIRE system retirement Due to the planned retirement of the Filing Information Returns Electronically (FIRE) System, the IRS is longer accepting new Information Returns (IR) Applications for Transmitter Control Codes (TCCs). Existing applicants can continue to update their applications through December 2026, after which they will become read-only and retained for historical reference. Current FIRE users must complete an Information Returns Intake System (IRIS) Application for TCC and transition to IRIS to file tax year 2026 information returns during the 2027 filing season. IRIS will be the only information returns electronic filing system, including current year, prior year, or corrections, after Jan. 1, 2027. For additional information, visit IRS.gov/iris . Key dates to remember Nov. 1, 2026: Last day to file test information returns through the FIRE Trading Partner Test System. Nov. 9, 2026: Last day to make changes to the IR Applications for TCCs. Nov. 19, 2026, at 3 p.m. ET: Last day to file information returns through the FIRE system. IR Application for TCC If you need to make changes to your existing IR Application for TCC, access the following: Access IR application for TCC For additional application information, review Publication 5911 PDF , Information Returns (IR) Application for Transmitter Control Code (TCC) Tutorial. Non-US based information returns filers should visit Foreign Filer Transmitter Control Code (TCC) Registration . Use Chatbot Tax professionals, get help with our new chat feature. Get answers to your questions about transmitter control codes (TCCs) and filing information returns electronically. For account-specific questions, you’ll need an IRS (ID.me) account . Access FIRE System Log in to FIRE or create a new FIRE account: Log in to FIRE FIRE System scheduled maintenance The FIRE Systems (production and test) have regularly scheduled maintenance windows every Sunday from 2-8 a.m. Eastern time and Wednesday from 2-5 a.m. Eastern time. See the applicable publication(s) linked on this webpage for additional information.
